newsitem.title: UK: Amoco restarts gas production at four N Sea fields.
newsitem.headline: Amoco restarts gas production at four N Sea fields.

text.p: Amoco Corp has restarted gas production at four North Sea fields following a suspension of output on Thursday because of a technical problem, a company spokesman said on Friday morning.
Gas production at the Indefatigable, Davy, Bessemer and Beaufort fields was halted on Thursday following a fault in an export condensate line from the Inde 23 Alpha platform.
The loss of production, coming on top of severe weather across Britain and interruptions to all available interruptible contracts in southern Britain, sent short term spot prices soaring.
But a company spokesman said that the line has been repressurised and gas is now flowing again.
